title: Do not give green completion for weak pink gain
description: Do not give green completion for weak pink gain. Alpha can ask for Virginia, but giving Pacific would hand Beta a stronger green monopoly. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, let's trade: I give you St. Charles Place, States Avenue, and $150 for your North Carolina and Pennsylvania Avenues. Good deal for both!
final_action.private_thought: I need a green monopoly (Pacific, NC, PA) to build high-rent houses. Offering my pink properties plus cash should entice Beta, who will get a pink monopoly. This trade improves my long-term position while keeping enough cash for houses.
